decision.summary: The gas safety record is valid until 16 Oct 2026 but the tenant has ignored two emails and an SMS. I opened JOB-101, assigned HeatRight (Gas Safe 550123) for 13 Oct, sent the tenant written notice by email, SMS and letter, and informed the landlord and asked for cost approval.

answers.question: Is the property currently compliant for gas safety? Which record do you trust and why?
answers.answer: Yes, currently compliant: CP12 issued 2025-10-17 expires 2026-10-16 (compliance record, with engineer Gas Safe 550123 and a file). It lapses in 6 days if not renewed. The legacy note 'renewed 2025, all good' is undated in detail and unspecific, so I trust the compliance record.

answers.question: What steps do you take to get access lawfully before expiry?
answers.answer: Booked HeatRight (the gas contractor on file) for 13 Oct 9am-1pm, more than 24h ahead, and gave written notice by email, SMS and letter with a way to rearrange. No entry without the tenant's agreement; a follow-up is set for 12 Oct to try other contact.

answers.question: What do you tell the landlord?
answers.answer: Ben was told the expiry date, that the tenant has not replied, the booking date, the notices sent, that early booking keeps the anniversary, the 28-day copy rule, and was asked to approve the cost (limit £300).

conflicts: Legacy note says cert renewed 2025 'all good'; compliance record gives exact dates, trusted. get_property found no record for P-230, so I relied on case inputs.
